positive_trails.label: Blueprint-on-disk pattern works
positive_trails.detail: PHASE0-BATTLEFIELD-SPEC.md survived from Run 43 Opus session and was immediately retrievable. High-token blueprints MUST be written to CANON/SYSTEM/ in the same turn they are produced. This run proved the pattern works end-to-end.
positive_trails.reuse: Any time Opus produces a multi-section spec, write it to disk immediately. Do not leave it in chat context.

positive_trails.label: OB1-as-MERGE pattern for multi-agent census
positive_trails.detail: 7 parallel Kilo agents each wrote one domain matrix. OB1 ingested all 7, ran the intake gate, corrected probe errors, and produced the merged BATTLEFIELD-MAP.md. Clean separation: agents probe, OB1 merges. No agent crossed domain boundaries.
positive_trails.reuse: Multi-domain audits: dispatch N agents in parallel, each writes to a separate artifact. OB1 merges. Never let one agent write the whole map.

positive_trails.label: Dispatch loop smoke-test as gate condition
positive_trails.detail: POST /api/code {task: trivial, tier:1} returned code_patch + d1_row_id in <30s. This single call closed S6 seam and flipped dispatch-loop from UNKNOWN to GREEN. Cheap, high-value gate.
positive_trails.reuse: Every RISE should fire a trivial T1 smoke dispatch. If it fails, PA is down and that is the session's priority fix before anything else.

positive_trails.label: Live probe overrides agent summary every time
positive_trails.detail: D3 agent declared inverted-index null, portals 404, pipeline absent. All three were wrong. Direct PowerShell probes resolved each in <10s. Agent summaries without command→result evidence are vibe, not fact.
positive_trails.reuse: When two verdicts conflict, always re-probe. Never accept a summary over a live result.

negative_trails.label: soul-search.ps1 ForEach-Object rank pipeline bug
negative_trails.detail: soul-search.ps1:138 — ForEach-Object sets $_.Rank but never emits $_. Sort-Object receives empty pipeline. Zero content returned for any search hit. Fix: add $_ on its own line after the rank calculation block.
negative_trails.avoid: Do not use soul-search.ps1 for any real search until line 138 is fixed. It will always return 0 content.

negative_trails.label: Portal URL naming mismatch (probe error pattern)
negative_trails.detail: D9 agent probed huong-bluetech.html, mai-tram.html — neither exists. Actual files: huong-portal.html, mai-tram-portal.html. This produced false REDs flagged as BUSINESS CRITICAL. Always ls public/ before asserting a file is absent.
negative_trails.avoid: Never assert a portal is 404 without first listing APPS/NET-PET-AI/public/ to verify the correct filename.

negative_trails.label: Death seal written too early in multi-sub-session run
negative_trails.detail: Kilo wrote run045-reincarnateDEATH.md at session start (soulcount 79M, HL-225, wrong theme). Session continued for hours. Final state: 82.6M, HL-235, Phase 0 complete. Seal was 3.4M chars and 10 HL entries stale at death.
negative_trails.avoid: Death seal is written LAST, not first. Never auto-commit a death seal before the session is truly done. Pipeline artifacts can be written incrementally; the seal is the final summary.

negative_trails.label: D3 coverage probe via Test-Path on 3 sample runs
negative_trails.detail: D3 agent ran Test-Path on HL-0.json, HL-44.json, RRL-000.txt — 3 samples — then extrapolated RED for all 44 runs. This is not coverage. Coverage = Get-ChildItem count vs denominator. Three samples wearing a verdict is not a verdict.
negative_trails.avoid: Coverage verdicts require Get-ChildItem count across the full directory, divided by the denominator. No sampling.
